notes: Access route: direct fetch (requests, desktop UA) succeeded on every page with HTTP 200 - no WAF/bot-block encountered, no impersonation/proxy/side-door needed. robots.txt checked first: no Claude-specific disallow; disallowed paths (search/query params, account/wishlist actions) were not used. Site is Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) 'Sites-liberty-Site'; category listing pages expose an exact '<N> Results' counter (breadcrumb-total + on-page text) used as ground truth for all counts except Glassware & Drinkware, which required manual title-level classification (see its evidence) because the parent page mixes decorative glassware with reusable water bottles and bar/coffee tools and the site's own sub-nav tabs are non-exhaustive. Scoped strictly to the Home department (https://www.libertylondon.com/uk/department/home/). Excluded entire sub-trees: Home Furnishings (cushions, bedding, wallpaper, footstools/furniture, throws, bathroom towels, furnishing fabrics - all textiles/furniture), Kitchen Accessories and Cookware (functional kitchenware), Storage (109 results but dominated by jewellery boxes/cases/pouches - not home decor, dropped as a mixed roll-up), Stationery and Games, Brands (brand-listing pages, never extracted), and all Discover/Featured/New In/Bestsellers/Exclusively Ours/Trending marketing pages. 'Shop By Room' (Bedroom/Bathroom/Living Room/Kitchen) pages were also dropped: they are cross-category room roll-ups mixing furniture, textiles and decor that duplicate products already counted under the specific categories above - extracting them would double-count. No standalone Mirrors or Clocks categories exist in the site's navigation; mirrors that do exist are folded into the Wall Art category (included there, satisfying Rule 0). Duplicate-company check: grepped all locally cached c*.json outputs in this batch's scratchpad for 'liberty' - no prior entry found, so this is treated as a first, non-duplicate extraction for S.N. 326.
